description: Topic extraction over the same interview. At least one topic label must reflect the central product; no topic may assert an absent subject.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Today we're joined by an engineer from Acme Corporation to talk about their new solar inverter, Helios.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Helios is our first inverter designed for residential rooftops, and it ships next quarter.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: What sets it apart from what's already on the market?

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: It runs cooler and it's about thirty percent lighter, which makes installation faster.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Let's talk about the residential solar market more broadly, then.

segments.speaker: Guest
segments.text: Demand has climbed steadily, especially for rooftop systems in suburban areas.
